title: Development of silicon-fluorescein-based photolabile protecting groups with enhanced uncaging quantum yield
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,11964-11971
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09470D, Paper
Open Access

Naoya Ieda, Miyu Tachi, Misuzu Noda, Mei Harada, Yuji Hotta, Kazuki Kondo, Haruka Tsuchiya, Mikako Ogawa, Mitsuyasu Kawaguchi, Hidehiko Nakagawa
Quantum chemistry-guided transition state stabilization of Si-fluorescein photolabile protecting groups achieved a 70-fold increase in uncaging efficiency, enabling the precise optomanipulation of biological events using orange light.
